title: Atlas relationship (v1)
description: A manual, catalogue-level typed link between two assets — held data expressing 'what runs on / connects to what'. NOT derived analysis: automatic integration mapping with ownership/criticality is paid Atlas core. See handbook 11 §1.

type.description: The manual relationship vocabulary. Open set of held link types; adding a value is non-breaking. 'part-of' also carries data-layer containment (column → dataset → data-area → system); 'joins-on' is a held cross-dataset join key (nøgle) between columns/datasets, not a measured/derived join.
